name: application-energy-usage-bar
title: Energy Usage Bar
description: A real-time watt-draw bar with a green-to-red intensity gradient, a peak-usage marker, and an estimated cost readout.
useWhen: Smart home, EV charging, or utility dashboards that need to show live power draw against a known scale and today's peak.
Pairing raw watt usage with an estimated cost helps users connect consumption to their bill in real time.
avoidWhen: You're tracking a generic budget/quota against a fixed limit — `Budget Progress Bar` fits that simpler use case without energy-specific framing.
You need historical usage over time rather than a live snapshot — a line or bar chart from `charts` fits trend data better.
responsiveBehavior: The bar and its min/peak/max label row scale to the card's full width; the peak marker's percentage-based position stays proportionally correct at any width.
accessibility: The peak marker is paired with a text label ("Peak: 2,850 W (6:40 PM)") stating the exact value and time, not conveyed by marker position alone.
The gradient fill communicates intensity, but the exact current draw is always shown as large text above the bar.
The usage-trend alert pairs an icon with descriptive text, not color alone, to convey the warning.

variants.title: Current draw
variants.description: A live 2,140W draw shown on a green-to-red gradient bar with a peak marker at 2,850W, min/max scale labels, an estimated daily cost, and a usage-trend alert.
accessibility: The peak marker's value and time are stated as visible text beside the bar, not solely as a line position.

variants.title: Current draw (Dark)
variants.description: Energy usage bar adapted for dark surfaces, including the gradient fill and alert banner colors.
accessibility: Bar gradient, peak marker, and alert text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
